scenes.setting: Farewell outside 15 Minsk Street: Emlyn hopes never to meet again — then lingers to ask what's cooking (chili peppers 'aren't things fancied by the Sanguine') and to argue the bill, while Klein's mind is already on beef bone radish soup
scenes.text_anchor: “Chili peppers aren’t things fancied by the Sanguine.”

scenes.setting: East Borough coffee shop, Thursday: fifteen soli render Old Kohler teary; his report — Aurora Order rumors of praying to the undead Creator among the poor, the crushed textile-workers' strike — and the news that Liv's youngest daughter has gone missing. 'I occasionally do volunteer work too.'
scenes.text_anchor: “By the way, Liv’s youngest daughter has gone missing.”

scenes.setting: A quiet parasol-tree street by the Yosifov Clinic: Fors, hunting inspiration, drifts to her dead mentor Aulisa's Unit 39 — where an old man from Midseashire, calling himself Laubero's elder brother, asks what became of the couple and invites her for coffee
scenes.text_anchor: “Beautiful lady, do you live in this district? Do you know Laubero and Aulisa?”

scenes.setting: Liv's humid East Borough room: the widow lifeless among laundry piles, her eldest daughter sobbing self-blame over the secluded alley where little sister vanished — until Liv snaps and screams at her to keep washing
scenes.text_anchor: “It’s all my fault. I didn’t watch over her properly…
